summary: Practise stay interviews, turnover analysis and manager retention planning. Explore the five-day talent management course and see if it fits your role.
lede: Retention training helps HR practitioners and people managers use turnover signals to guide practical efforts to retain valued employees. Participants practise interpreting retention measures, conducting stay interviews and identifying development barriers. They also create manager action plans and follow-up measures, using the employee lifecycle and ISO 30414 as reference points; AI-assisted analytics and human-capital reporting are introduced conceptually, not as system-building exercises.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who shape employee experience, development and retention through HR practice or direct people management. It suits foundation-level learners who need practical methods for turning employee feedback and turnover information into focused actions.
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with team supervision or HR processes is useful. No coding or programming is required.
